title: Communicating with other areas: management, HR, legal and vendors

videos.script: Support talks to users all day. It also talks to four other groups, and each one needs something different. {{four}} Management needs decisions it can make, with what each option costs. HR tells you who is joining and leaving, and needs you to act the same day. Legal needs you to preserve things exactly as they are. Vendors need evidence before they repair anything. {{each}} This lesson goes through the four, with a real message to two of them, written from the tickets of earlier lessons. {{messages}}
